summary: round 1 (draft supersede-2 at 6e039a9): exhaustive review of all 11 draft files against the frozen spec (docs/specs unchanged since 2a0d38e). Q50-Q63 are implemented; NFR-007 and C-2 match Q57 verbatim; SDD sections 2, 3, 6, 10, 12.1, 13 and 14, ADR-0001/0002/0011/0012/0014/0018 and the three contracts are consistent; every requirement traces to section 14. D-45 form holds: no draft notes, YAML comment blocks or copy/delete steps; nothing outside requirements.md, sdd.md, contracts/ and adr/; no frozen file removed (contracts/todo-api-v1.yaml present). Q63 complete: no todos-api-v1.yaml in the draft, every cross-file ref resolves to an existing component of common-problem-v1.yaml, and ADR-0012 L5-L8 and ADR-0018 L30-L32 state why the to-dos file keeps its name. tool-spikes.md citations resolve. No blocker or major; 6 minor and 5 info findings.

findings.message: The context paragraph lists the second supersede answers that change only the SDD, ADRs and contracts as Q50, Q52-Q56, Q58, Q59, Q60 and Q63, but omits Q61 and Q62; Q62 changed SDD section 10, section 12.1 item 19, ADR-0012 and ADR-0018 (round-3 F-1, F-2, F-6).
findings.suggestion: Write Q50, Q52-Q56 and Q58-Q63 (or name Q61 and Q62 explicitly).

findings.message: The section 12.1 lead cites Q51, Q56-Q58 and Q63 as the source of items 11-20, but item 19 (RequestIdFilter on REQUEST and ERROR dispatches) comes from Q62; and it says item 21 was decided by the requester in Q60, while Q60 decided only the Spring Boot 4.x line, not the switch to openapi-request-validator-core 3.0.0 and its v3 MockMvc adapter, which is an engineering consequence for the approver to confirm.
findings.suggestion: Add Q62 to the sources of items 11-20, and say the Boot 4.x line of item 21 was decided in Q60 while its validator choice follows from it and is confirmed by approving the freeze.

findings.message: Q60 moved the backend to the latest Spring Boot 4.x line, but the starter list on the same page is unchanged from the frozen file (spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-test). Spring Boot 4.0 modularised its starters (the web starter is superseded by spring-boot-starter-webmvc, Flyway auto-configuration needs its own starter, test slices moved to per-technology test starters); ADR-0014 likewise still assumes Flyway auto-configures from the Flyway dependency alone. Stated from knowledge of the 4.0 release, not verified against a primary source in this session.
findings.suggestion: Name the Boot 4.x starters, or state that the java-engineer uses the starter names the pinned 4.x release defines (including the Flyway starter, with a matching note in ADR-0014).

findings.message: The Context still says the module layout is open, then in the next sentence says the requester chose a modular monolith (C-2), and the Boot line is now fixed by Q60; one line also runs far past the file wrap width.
findings.suggestion: Say only the Java version, build tool and starters were open; the module layout is fixed by C-2 (Q51) and ADR-0018. Rewrap the paragraph.

findings.message: The licence and maintenance of the new v3 validator artifacts are stated as unverified, not rechecked for v3, and no check is assigned, unlike the artifact id, which the java-engineer must confirm. ADR-0001 holds the dependency set to MIT or Apache-2.0.
findings.suggestion: Have the java-engineer confirm the Apache-2.0 licence in the Maven Central POM of both v3 artifacts when pinning, and stop and report a spec question if it differs; drop the parenthetical.

findings.message: D-45 step 1 names requirements-analyst as the author of a requirements.md draft; this draft was written by spec-author (commit 8eefb35, Drafted by spec-author) and stamped with agent spec-author. The content is the Q57 wording accepted verbatim, so this is a process departure, not a content defect; the stamp itself must not be hand-edited.
findings.suggestion: Orchestrator: record the departure on the PR, or have requirements-analyst confirm the draft and re-stamp with that agent if the harness expects it.

findings.message: The label supersede-2 (the proposal folder name) remains as provenance in the SDD and ADR status lines; it parallels the frozen round 2 and first supersede wording, so it is not a D-45 draft note, but requirements.md calls the same thing the second supersede.
findings.suggestion: Optionally use the second supersede consistently (also adr/0002 L3-L4, adr/0018 L3).

findings.message: The first freeze is used for the state this supersede replaces (sdd.md L696, L712, L750; adr/0012 L6, L19, L28; adr/0018 L8, L24, L31), although the current frozen state is the supersede-1 re-freeze at 2a0d38e; the names referred to date from the first freeze and were kept, so the text is accurate but could be read as skipping supersede-1.
findings.suggestion: Optionally say the frozen spec or before this supersede.

findings.message: The contract lint (web script lint:contracts, redocly lint, @redocly/cli dev dependency) is a new verification step no Q50-Q63 answer asked for; it is disclosed as an engineering default in section 12.1 item 17 and section 13, so the approver confirms it with the freeze.
findings.suggestion: None required; the approver should note it.

findings.message: The shared NotFound response keeps the frozen to-do-specific description in the common file, which the identity module never lists; acknowledged in section 12.1 item 16.
findings.suggestion: None; frozen wording kept with no wire effect.
